sourceFile: 77. TIU C11-20 Report test improve don't press jig VP+ Coil 2026.04.21_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor and row-pair grouping are materially wrong.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly treats models and positions as test conditions.
Left/right normal controls use wrong carried-down model rows.
R-side set-height result uses L normal values instead of R normal row.
Detection-position sections are capability checks, not changed-factor levels.
Two sheets may need separate changed factors or clearly nested outcomes.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the two sheets be separate improvement cases or one combined jig-detection validation?
correctionPlan: Define changed factor as added sensor or set-height check versus normal/no check.
Use model L and R as subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Pair L tests with L normal rows and R tests with R normal rows.
Keep position 1-4 rows as detection capability outcomes under each sheet.
Recalculate R-side NG rates and cite all paired rows including row 21.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because key paired control rows are misused or omitted.
